Self.Wiki: This map object represents an in-game entity, used for enemies, characters and interaction points that make use of the Talk system.

Enemy_ActionButtonParamID.Wiki: The action button parameters to use for 'hacking' an enemy. -1 for none.

NPCParamID.Wiki: The property parameters this character should use.

ThinkParamID.Wiki: The AI parameters this character should use.

TalkID.Wiki: The ID of a talk ESD used by the character.

Enemy_Unk16.Wiki: Read by the game. 0 on most enemies; 10-600 on 27.

CharaInitID.Wiki: The ID in CharaInitParam determining equipment and stats for humans.

CollisionPartName.Wiki: The collision that controls loading of the enemy.

WalkRouteName.Wiki: The walk route this enemy follows.

Enemy_Unk22.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 on most enemies, otherwise values such as 1, 10, 100, 200, 300, 600.

BackupEventAnimID.Wiki: The animation ID for this enemy to idle with.

Enemy_LinkedEntityID.Wiki: Read by the game. Appears to be a secondary entity ID for this enemy; 0 for none.

Enemy_Unk44.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 on most enemies, otherwise small values (0-171).

Enemy_Unk48.Wiki: Read by the game. 0, or 60 on 8 enemies in m01_04_80_00 (Xylem).

Enemy_Unk55.Wiki: A mode read by character code: 0, 1 or 2. Only 2 on AC enemy Nosaac in m01_03_70_00.

KillPayoutClassification.Wiki: Determines the kill payout classification when this enemy is killed during destruction-pay missions. Differs per mission.

PartsTokenParamID.Wiki: The parts token this enemy will drop.

UnkEnemyStruct70.Wiki: Five values the game reads as a list. Their values (0-330 in steps of 15/30, -1 for unused) look like angles in degrees.
